deck_title: Ashikhmin-Shirley subtractive Fresnel-diffuse transmittance vs naive additive grazing rim blowout rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Michael Ashikhmin & Peter Shirley (JGT 2000) & Kelemen-Szirmay-Kalos (2001) subtractive Fresnel-diffuse transmittance coupling (T_diff(mu) = 1 - F(mu), locking total dielectric albedo E_coupled(mu) = (1 - F(mu)) + F(mu) = 1.0000x for F_0 = 0.0400) versus legacy uncoupled additive diffuse + specular (E_naive(mu) = 1 + F(mu), inflating grazing rim albedo to 2.0000x) and 64-bounce internal Stokes subsurface series summation across 17 viewing cosine stations (mu in [1.0000, 0.0000]).
